card.name: The letter i inside bacter- and arter- words
card.fires_on: The letter "i" right after "bacter" or "arter" when a longer medical word is being spelled out, such as bacteriologic, bacteriostatic, bacteriuria, arteriography and arteriolar.

modes.label: After bacter-
modes.description: The "i" in bacteriologic, bacteriostatic or bacteriuria.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with word endings such as -ology, -ometry and -olis, which finish a long medical term.
card.plain: It marks the spot inside words like bacteriostatic or arteriography where the next letters complete the term.
